_comment: The closure of vLLM code that the engine-path costs depend on, for the release named below. People edit this file; gen_code_paths.py (blis-substrate tools/codepaths) refuses a function that is not in the source and hashes the rest into code_paths.json. host: the work host_admission_*, host_output_token, host_completion and host_step_per_request price. graphs: the launch work host_launch_* and host_replay_graph_per_step price. Add a function here when a cost starts to depend on it; its code then changes the path's CodeID.

host.why: the front end's entry for a request: where host_admission_per_request is spent
turns the prompt into an engine-core request; the per-prompt-token and per-request admission work
tokenizes the prompt: the work host_admission_per_token prices
the engine core's per-request admission before the scheduler sees it
incremental detokenization of each emitted token: host_output_token
the per-token decode the fast detokenizer runs under update
the loop that handles a step's outputs request by request: host_output_token
completion bookkeeping when a request finishes: host_completion
the scheduler's per-step, per-request work: host_step_per_request
the scheduler's per-step, per-request update from a step's output: host_step_per_request
applies one request's step output in the scheduler: host_step_per_request
finishing a request in the scheduler: host_completion
the teardown of a finished request: host_completion

graphs.why: chooses eager, piecewise or full graph for a step: which launch cost applies
pads the step to a captured graph's shape: whether a replay is taken
decides how a step executes (graph mode, padding): host_replay_graph_per_step against host_launch_*
replays a captured graph or runs eagerly: host_replay_graph_per_step, host_launch_per_kernel
